from collections import Counter
def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r)
    # separator color = color forming a full row
    sepc=None
    for r in range(H):
        if len(set(inp[r]))==1: sepc=inp[r][0]; break
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    # region origin: first cell whose color != bg and != sep
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    r0=c0=None
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if inp[r][c] not in (bg,sepc): r0,c0=r,c
    reg=[(r-r0,c-c0,inp[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c] not in (bg,sepc)]
    # find separator lines
    rowsL=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(inp[r]))==1 and inp[r][0]!=bg]
    colsL=[c for c in range(W) if all(inp[r][c]==inp[0][c] for r in range(H)) and inp[0][c]!=bg]
    rowbounds=sorted(rowsL); colbounds=sorted(colsL)
    seg_rows=[]; prev=0
    for rr in rowbounds+[H]:
        seg_rows.append((prev,rr)); prev=rr+1
    seg_cols=[]; prev=0
    for cc in colbounds+[W]:
        seg_cols.append((prev,cc)); prev=cc+1
    Rg=(r0,H-1)
    rs=[]; pc=[]
    for a,b in seg_rows:
        if a<=Rg[0]<=b-1 and a<=Rg[1]<=b-1: pass
    # bounding box of seeds may span multiple regions; simplify: stamp every region cell using pattern offset
    for ra in seg_rows:
        for ca in seg_cols:
            ar,ac=ra[0],ca[0]
            for dr,dc,col in reg:
                rr,cc=ar+dr,ac+dc
                if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and inp[rr][cc] not in (sepc,) : out[rr][cc]=col
    return out
